description: This file contains functions related to processing and translating documentation files with frontmatter tags, including parsing, translation, and maintaining document integrity during i18n operations.

methods.name: processFileDoc
methods.description: Processes a documentation file, translating its frontmatter and body content based on source and target languages, handling file existence checks, and updating translated content.

methods.name: formatTaggedDocument
methods.description: Formats frontmatter and body into a tagged document string with start and end tags.

methods.name: parseTaggedDocument
methods.description: Parses a tagged document string to extract frontmatter and body sections, validating structure.

methods.name: buildFrontmatterTemplate
methods.description: Builds a frontmatter template from a data map, generating markers for fields like summary, title, and read_when.

methods.name: applyFrontmatterTranslations
methods.description: Applies translated frontmatter content to the data map based on markers found in the translated document.

methods.name: extractMarkerValue
methods.description: Extracts the value between specific start and end marker strings within the translated frontmatter.

methods.name: setReadWhenValue
methods.description: Sets a specific read_when value at an index within the existing read_when array.

methods.name: shouldSkipDoc
methods.description: Determines whether to skip processing the document based on existing output content and source hash comparison.

methods.name: resolveDocsPath
methods.description: Resolves and validates absolute and relative paths of documentation files within a specified root directory.
